description: Gate 1 (P0-A) cross-integrator comparison: Heun/RK2 versus SSPRK3 and classical RK4 on the identical spatial discretization, identical E-29 initial datum and identical fixed time-step series. Heun-only amplification must never be used for candidate decisions; this run measures whether the three schemes agree to far below the spatial error at the shipped operating point.
preregistration_note: Tolerances fixed before the run. The measured Heun temporal sensitivity of the final amplification on this grid is ~4.4e-6 relative per dt halving (outputs/hou_time_refinement_v1), so 1e-3 is two decades of headroom; a violation signals scheme-dependent dynamics (e.g. instability contamination), which is a Gate 1 stop condition, not a tuning target.
